cohort: The study included 13 hospitalized patients (mean age, 56.69 years; 10 men, 3 women) from a single University Hospital, admitted between April 1, 2020, and April 30, 2022, who tested positive for COVID-19 and developed acute abdominal pain.
finding: Thromboembolic complications, specifically abdominal thromboses, can be seen in hospitalized patients with COVID-19, and multimodality ultrasound examinations are helpful for their early and accurate diagnosis.
